steps.label: Repo-per-env
steps.sub: separate config repo per env, or app-repo vs. config-repo

code:
apps/payments-api/
  base/
    deployment.yaml
    kustomization.yaml
  overlays/
    dev/      # replicas: 1
    staging/  # replicas: 2
    prod/     # replicas: 6
caption: Each overlay references the base and patches only what differs for that environment.

code:
# overlays/staging/kustomization.yaml
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: replica-patch.yaml
images:
  - name: payments-api
    newTag: v1.4.2
caption: Promotion is often a one-line image-tag bump in a reviewable PR.
